summary: Validated 'From Couch to Road' plan/calendar/workout flows for rider 'Green Lantern'. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (rider profile, /api/plan title+phases+goals+ctr-ride ids, /api/calendar/week Week 1 with 27 Jul 2026 start, cycling ids ctr-ride-1/2/3, per-day slots incl. readiness). Frontend: Plan screen renders 'From Couch to Road' + 4 phases (Get Moving / Build the Foundation / Extend Your Endurance / Road Ready) + Plan Goals + Weekly Load + Key Workouts (Welcome Ride, Pedal Smoothly, First Endurance Ride). Tapping a Key Workout card navigates to /workout?workoutId=ctr-ride-1&title=Welcome%20Ride with STEP 1/5 timeline. Calendar screen renders the 27 Jul – 2 Aug 2026 week with cycling in TRAINING row, strength in STRENGTH & MOBILITY (FB50) row, recovery in RECOVERY & WELLNESS row; selecting Tuesday's 'Welcome Ride' -> View Workout opens Live Workout with STEP 1/5. Direct /workout?workoutId=ctr-ride-3 loads 'First Endu…' with a real 5-step interval timeline (STEP 1/5). Today's Training (/training) 'Start Workout' navigates to /workout?workoutId=ctr-ride-1 without crashing. No red-screen errors; only benign web-preview warnings (textShadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver on web).

issues: Main workout card still displays 'Threshold Climb' (advanced) as the featured Today's Training session, but the 'Start Workout' CTA correctly routes into a Green-Lantern couch-to-road ride (ctr-ride-1). Consider surfacing the current couch-to-road day (e.g. Welcome Ride on Tue 28 Jul) on /training so what the user sees matches what the button launches.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' Emitted multiple times on /plan and /calendar (RN Web deprecation).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' on /calendar.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Replace deprecated RN Web props: migrate textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius to the shorthand `textShadow` style, and move `pointerEvents` from props to `style.pointerEvents` in the components used on /plan and /calendar to silence web deprecation warnings.

(UX polish) Make /training's featured workout match the couch-to-road day-of-week for Green Lantern (currently shows Threshold Climb even though Start Workout correctly launches Welcome Ride / ctr-ride-1).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend hardcodes the couch-to-road Week 1 (_CTR_WEEK1) in server.py — future weeks (2–16) will need to be exposed similarly or the endpoint made week-aware so the calendar continues to work past Aug 2.
frontend/src/lib/programs/couch-to-road.ts is a single very large file (>1000 lines by structure); consider splitting per-phase to keep files under the 700-line guideline.
seed_data_creation: None — rider profile 'Green Lantern' already seeded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Rider 'Green Lantern' triggers the beginner plan via case-insensitive name match. /api/plan returns From Couch to Road with 4 phases + 3 goals + key workouts ctr-ride-1/2/3. /api/calendar/week returns Week 1 starting 2026-07-27; each day carries cycling+strength+recovery+readiness.
